name: i-sda
description: Interactive visual designer for IBM i DDS display files (DSPF) — preview, click, drag, and edit fields with changes written straight back into the DDS source.

enumDescriptions: Open the designer full-width in the same tab, replacing the split (default) - less cramped, since you don't need the source visible at the same time.
Open the designer in a split column next to the DDS source - lets you see the source and the visual designer side by side.
Open the designer and automatically pop it out into its own window.
isda.designerOpenColumn.description: Where iSDA opens the Screen/Menu Designer, for "Open Screen/Menu Design Preview" and for newly created display files/menus.

isda.trackSourceModifications.description: Screen Designer: when a keyword/field/record edit changes an existing source line, comment out the original line instead of overwriting it (so its history stays in the file), and tag the new/changed line with the Modification tag (columns 81-90, past what the DDS compiler reads). This is the DEFAULT for newly opened designer sessions - it can also be toggled per-session from the Properties panel without changing this setting.

isda.keepRemovedLines.description: Screen and Menu Designer: when an edit removes source lines (a keyword taken off, a field or record deleted), keep them in the source as comment lines instead of dropping them, so no sequence number, OR marker or tag is lost. Ignored while Track source modifications is on with a tag, which already comments out what it replaces.

isda.hover.enable.description: Show keyword help when hovering a keyword in the text editor for display-file and menu sources: its level, parameters, option-indicator rules and the DDS Reference section it comes from.

isda.outline.enable.description: Show display-file and menu sources in the Outline view, the breadcrumbs and Go to Symbol: one entry per record format with its fields, constants and help specifications under it.

isda.definition.enable.description: Go to Definition on a record-format name inside SFLCTL(...), WINDOW(...) and MNUBARCHC(...) jumps to that record format.

isda.columnAids.enable.description: Draw the fixed DDS columns (sequence number, form type, conditioning, name type, name, reference, length, data type, decimals, usage, line, position, keyword area) as subtle bands on the line the cursor is on in display-file and menu sources opened in the text editor, and name each column when hovering it.

isda.quickFix.enable.description: Offer quick-fixes on the iSDA problems of display-file and menu sources in the text editor: remove the conflicting keyword, or add the companion keyword a rule says is missing (OVERLAY for PUTRETAIN, INDARA for RETKEY). The edit is made the way the designers make it, so the modification tag and isda.keepRemovedLines apply.

isda.quickFix.openInDesigner.description: Add "Open in designer" to the quick-fix menu of an iSDA problem, to fix it there instead.

isda.completion.enable.description: Offer keyword completion in the text editor for display-file and menu sources: the keywords valid at the level you are typing at (file, record, field, help specification), with a parameter snippet.

isda.completion.filterByRules.description: Keyword completion leaves out a keyword the DDS rules would flag at that place (a conflict with a keyword the record already has, a usage or data type it does not accept). Turn off to list every keyword of the level.

isda.diagnostics.enable.description: Show DDS rule violations in the Problems panel for display-file and menu sources opened in the text editor (the same rules the designers enforce).

isda.diagnostics.severity.description: Severity per rule code: error (the default), warning, information, hint, or off. Example: { "isda.windowDependency": "warning" }.

enumDescriptions: Columns 81-90 (up to 10 characters), past what the DDS compiler reads.
Columns 1-5 (up to 5 characters), the sequence-number area, which replaces the line's sequence number.
isda.modificationTagPosition.description: Screen and Menu Designer: where the Modification tag is written on a new/changed source line when modification tracking is on. The Properties panel's "Tag in columns 1-5" toggle overrides it per session; the tag is limited to 5 characters in columns 1-5.

enumDescriptions: Not set: the connected job's DATSEP when connected, otherwise a slash.
isda.previewDateSeparator.description: Screen Designer: the date separator the preview draws for EDTCDE(Y) and EDTCDE(W) when no IBM i connection can supply the job's DATSEP. The connected job's DATSEP always wins; with neither, a slash (IBM's default) is used. It changes only the character drawn, never the field's width.

enumDescriptions: A self-contained HTML page (the drawing, no script, no remote file)
Plain text, one character per screen cell
isda.export.defaultFormat.description: Screen Designer and Menu Designer: the format the Export screen button and the iSDA: Export Screen Preview command save in. The list beside the button saves in any format or copies to the clipboard.

isda.export.pngScale.description: Screen Designer and Menu Designer: how many pixels a PNG export uses per drawing unit (1x, 2x or 3x). 2x stays sharp on a high-resolution display.

isda.export.ruler.description: Screen Designer and Menu Designer: add the row and column numbers (the designer's ruler) to an exported screen.

enumDescriptions: Window and pull-down borders as box-drawing characters
Window and pull-down borders as + - | (for a tool that cannot show box-drawing characters)
isda.export.textStyle.description: Screen Designer and Menu Designer: how a plain-text export draws borders.

isda.messageFiles.markdownDescription: Screen Designer: the message files you use most, as `LIB/MSGF` or `MSGF` (searched through the library list). The message-ID picker (Browse... in the ERRMSGID, SFLMSGID, MSGID and CHKMSGID panels) offers them in a list and opens the first one when the panel names no message file. Never written to the DDS source. Entries that are not valid IBM i names are ignored.

isda.modificationTag.description: Screen Designer: default 10-character tag written to columns 81-90 of any new/changed source line when modification tracking is on. Only used as the STARTING value for the Properties panel's own session-only Modification tag box - editing it there doesn't change this setting.

editor/title.when: resourceExtname =~ /\.(dspf|DSPF|dspf38)$/ || resourceLangId == dds.dspf || resourceScheme == member || resourceScheme == streamfile
